description: HP-44 is the Registration and Licensing Authority (RLA) for the Churah subdivision in the Chamba district of Himachal Pradesh. Operated under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, it manages vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and local transport compliance in the mountainous Tissa region.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Churah at Tissa, District Chamba, Himachal Pradesh
